name: D-QR REST API
description:
The REST API for D-QR.

## Authentication

Most endpoints take two headers: `X-Client-ID` with your client id, and `Authorization: Bearer <client_secret>`. Credentials are generated from the dashboard under Developer API and require a plan carrying `api_access`.

The mobile app authenticates differently: `POST /auth/login` returns an `mqt_` token which is sent as `Authorization: Bearer mqt_…` with no `X-Client-ID`. Both modes reach the same endpoints; which plans may use them differs.

## Rate limiting

Authenticated endpoints allow 60 requests per minute keyed by client id, and carry `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset`. The `/auth/*` endpoints allow 10 per minute, because those are the ones a credential run hits. A 429 carries `Retry-After`.

## Plan features

Some endpoints additionally need a feature flag on the account — noted per endpoint as `x-plan-feature`. A token that authenticates fine still gets a 403 from those without it, so a 403 on a valid token is a plan question rather than a credential one.

## Errors

Errors are JSON with an `error` key. A 422 from a validated endpoint also carries `messages`, keyed by field — except in production, where the field names and rules are withheld because they are useful to whoever is probing the endpoint and to nobody else.
